name: Natsugami-ke ni Okita Koto Plus
original_name: 夏神家に起きたこと ぷらす
source:
In the previous work, Haruna made a mistake... however, behind the scenes, a man was looming over her mother, Mikoto.
Mikoto, who had given up on sex after giving birth to Haruna, experiences lascivious days. She tries to stick to her role as a mother, but where will it lead her?
translation:
前作中，桃犯下了一个错误……然而，在背后，一个男人的身影，也正逼近她的母亲美心。
生下桃后便远离性生活的美心，即将经历一段淫靡的日子。她试图坚守自己身为母亲的立场，可这份坚持，最终会将她带向何方？
